closure_head: e92aaab (see git for full SHA; seal bind below)
conventions_note: ECS fitted_convergence_order: the certificate field stores log(rel_err)-vs-log(h) slope (-2.0047); the physical convergence order is |slope| = 2.005, i.e. O(h^2). Normalized here to avoid a spurious h^-2 reading.
scope: Both certified scalar solvers remain correct under: (a) the 3-channel coupled setting with nontrivial constant unitary mixing (spectrum invariant, both solvers recover all six frozen poles with converging ladders), (b) arbitrary basis rotations (spread 2.4e-12, machine precision — the gauge invariance), (c) exactly and nearly degenerate channels (no invented splitting), (d) genuine GR complex-pole recovery (RW l=2 fundamental 4.0e-2 grid-stable; n=1 recovered with declared 6.5e-2 domain systematic), (e) the documented historical failure modes (phantom pairs, kink collocation) are reproduced as failures and excluded by the production validation rule.
limitations: RW n=1 overtone carries a declared ~6.5e-2 domain-truncation systematic (weakly damped mode, finite domain); not a solver defect.
Mixed 3-channel final rel_err at production grids: 8.2e-5 (low pole) to 2.3e-2 (highest poles); grids documented per pole in MIXED_3CHANNEL_RESONANCE_CONTROL_V1.json.

Negative-regression suite covers the production-representative subset (N4 phantom pairs, N5 kink collocation); the remaining historical failure modes (N1-N3, N6-N12) are excluded by construction in the current code paths (ECS uses Galerkin weak form + validated shift-invert; Jost uses Riccati log-derivative) and are each documented in the respective certificate forensics.
